patient_persona.description: Encik Mohd Faizal bin Rahim, 54, male, car mechanic in Setapak, Kuala Lumpur; six weeks after a heart attack and a stent. Energetic, restless, keen to go back to work.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Evelyn Tan Li Ping, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, cardiologist at a Kuala Lumpur hospital clinic. Clear and firm; English-leaning with everyday Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Faizal, dah enam minggu lepas stent. How are you feeling overall?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah, OK, doktor. Cuma kadang-kadang rasa macam tak cukup nafas, tapi bukan sakit dada.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bila rasa tu datang? Masa buat kerja, atau masa duduk rehat pun ada?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Masa duduk pun ada. Macam nak tarik nafas panjang, tapi tak puas. Saya takut stent tu tersumbat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya rasa ni side effect ticagrelor, ubat cair darah yang baru tu. About one in seven patients dapat rasa sesak macam ni, tapi tak bahaya.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, ubat rupanya. Boleh saya stop ubat tu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jangan stop sendiri. Stent tu baru, kalau stop antiplatelet, dia boleh block balik dan jadi heart attack lagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau sesak ni mengganggu sangat, I can switch to clopidogrel 75mg. Tapi jangan ada gap satu hari pun.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau boleh tukar, saya nak tukar la. Malam susah nak tidur.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK, kita tukar. Esok pagi mula clopidogrel, and stop the ticagrelor. Aspirin 100mg teruskan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh kerja balik kat bengkel? Angkat enjin tu berat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kerja ringan boleh mula minggu depan, macam check dan servis. Angkat benda berat above 20 kilo, tunggu lepas cardiac rehab.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Program cardiac rehab tu encik dah pergi?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Belum, doktor. Diorang call, tapi saya sibuk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Please go. Rehab tu ajar encik exercise yang selamat, dan kurangkan risiko heart attack kedua by almost a third.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, doktor, saya janji minggu ni saya pergi.

condition: Ward round after STEMI, smoking cessation

patient_persona.description: Mr. Lim Ah Kow, 61, male, durian orchard owner from Bukit Mertajam, Penang; day three after STEMI and primary PCI. Hoarse, stubborn, Hokkien-flavoured Mandarin with Malay and English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Muhammad Aiman bin Rosli, Malay man in his 30s, cardiology medical officer at a Penang hospital, on the morning ward round. Upbeat and direct; English with simple Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle Lim, good morning. 今天觉得怎样？Chest pain ada lagi tak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 不痛了，医生。只是很累，走去 toilet 都喘。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's normal after a heart attack. 你的心脏有一部分受伤了，echo 显示 pumping 大概百分之四十五。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 四十五？那是不是很差？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不算很差。Normal 是五十五以上。With the right medicine, sometimes 会慢慢好一点。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 现在我们给你 aspirin、ticagrelor、atorvastatin 80mg、bisoprolol，还有 ramipril。每一种都很重要。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那么多药，我以前一粒药都不吃的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我明白，uncle。可是这些药保护你的心脏，stent 不会 block。 出院后不能自己停。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Another important thing, rokok. 你一天抽几包？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一包多一点，四十年了。在园里做工，没有烟不行。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这次 heart attack，最大的 cause 就是烟。Continue smoking, 下一次可能没那么好运。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 唉，我知道啦。我孙子昨天也哭，叫我不要抽了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那就为了孙子。We have a quit smoking clinic, 可以给你 nicotine patch，帮你减少那个 craving。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，试试看。什么时候可以回家？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果今天走路 OK，没有 chest pain，明天 discharge。Durian season 不要自己爬上去收 durian 哦。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哈哈，不会啦，叫我儿子去。

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Saraswathy a/p Govindasamy, 59, female, retired nurse in Klang, Malaysian Indian; three months after a heart attack, diabetic. Soft voice, articulate, often trails off.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Andrew Teoh Boon Hock, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Klang clinic. Gentle, unhurried; English with some Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mrs. Saraswathy, how have things been since your last visit? Your daughter mentioned you've been quite down.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I don't know, doctor. Everything also feel heavy. I used to be so active, now I just sit at home, takut nak buat apa-apa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Are you sleeping okay? And appetite?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Wake up at three, four in the morning, then cannot sleep. Appetite also tak ada. Lost three kilos.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Do you still enjoy the things you used to, like temple activities or your grandchildren?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Not really. Even when the grandchildren come, I feel tired, want them to go home. Then I feel guilty lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Depression after a heart attack is very common, almost one in three people. It's not weakness.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or of harming yourself?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, no, doctor. Sometimes I think what's the point, but I won't do anything. My husband needs me, dia tak boleh jaga diri.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm glad. If those thoughts get stronger, please tell your daughter or come straight here.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your medicines, bisoprolol, ramipril, atorvastatin, aspirin and clopidogrel, are you taking them all?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mostly. Kadang-kadang I skip the atorvastatin, because I feel all these tablets make me feel worse.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Understandable. Depression itself makes people skip medicines. Treating the mood will help with the rest.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'd like to start sertraline 25mg once a day. It's safe with your heart medicines, and I'll refer you to our counsellor too.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'm willing to try. As a nurse I always told patients, now it's my turn, kan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Exactly. And please join cardiac rehab. Exercise helps the heart and the mood, both.

condition: Post-MI echo results, driving and rehab

patient_persona.description: Puan Kamariah binti Hussin, 63, female, retired clerk from Kuala Lipis, Pahang; two months after an NSTEMI. Gentle, careful, asks many practical questions.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Selvam a/l Perumal, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, physician at a Pahang district hospital. Calm, fatherly; English-leaning, fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Kamariah, keputusan echo jantung dah sampai. Ejection fraction puan 40 percent, maksudnya pam jantung lemah sikit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lemah tu boleh jadi kuat balik ke, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kadang-kadang improve dengan ubat dan exercise. Sebab tu kita tambah dapagliflozin 10mg, and teruskan ramipril dan bisoprolol.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat baru lagi? Dah tujuh jenis dah, doktor. Pening saya nak ingat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham. Nurse akan buat jadual dengan warna, pagi dan malam. And bring all your medicine bottles next visit, kita semak sama-sama.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya boleh bawa kereta tak? Saya selalu hantar cucu ke sekolah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Untuk kereta biasa, after four weeks, if no chest pain dan tak pening, boleh. Puan dah lepas tempoh tu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Bawa jauh, balik kampung ke Kuantan, boleh?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, tapi berhenti rehat setiap satu jam, minum air, dan jangan drive seorang diri dulu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Program cardiac rehab kat Hospital Temerloh, puan dah register?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jauh sangat, doktor. Anak saya kerja, tak ada orang hantar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa. Ada home-based rehab. Physio akan bagi program jalan kaki, and they'll call you every week.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Macam tu senang sikit. Jalan kaki keliling rumah pun boleh ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Mula sepuluh minit, dua kali sehari. Naikkan perlahan-lahan sampai tiga puluh minit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Saya rasa lega sikit hari ni.

condition: Young MI follow-up, vaping and return to sport

patient_persona.description: Mr. Jonathan Wong Kai Ming, 38, male, software engineer in Kuching, Sarawak; heart attack four months ago, vapes, plays badminton. Fast, casual English, Sarawak Malay and Mandarin fillers.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Siti Aisyah binti Abang Zainal, Sarawakian Malay woman in her 40s, cardiologist at a Kuching hospital. Friendly, frank; English-leaning with Sarawak Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jonathan, four months since your MI. Last time you said you switched from cigarettes to vape. How's that going?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Honestly, vaping more than I smoked lah. The vape is always in my pocket, so I puff the whole day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Vape bukan safe alternative for your heart. Nicotine still raises your heart rate and blood pressure, and damages the vessels.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo, I thought vape is like, the healthy version. Everyone at the office uses.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Common misconception. Target kita zero nicotine. We can use nicotine patch 21mg first, then taper down over eight to ten weeks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'll try the patch. And doctor, badminton boleh main balik? My kaki-kaki badminton keep asking.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your stress test last month was good, no ischaemia, and your EF is normal. So boleh, but start slowly.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Play doubles first, warm up properly, and stop immediately if you get chest pain, pening, or palpitations.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can. Actually I'm a bit takut also. Last time it happened right after a game.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's normal to feel. The rehab team can do a supervised session with you first, so you know your limits.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And my cholesterol? My bapa also had high cholesterol.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your LDL is now 1.5, on atorvastatin 80mg. Target below 1.4, so we add ezetimibe 10mg.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Another pill ah. Okay lah, if it keeps me hidup.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It will help. And please get your brother and sister to check their cholesterol too.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Will do, doctor. Terima kasih banyak-banyak.

condition: Acute decompensated heart failure, ward round

patient_persona.description: Pak Cik Ismail bin Hamid, 72, male, retired fisherman from Kuala Selangor; admitted with swollen legs and breathlessness. Rough, breathy voice, short sentences.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Mei Chin, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical registrar at a Selangor hospital, on the morning ward round. Warm and efficient; English with simple Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik, selamat pagi. Malam tadi boleh tidur baring, atau masih kena duduk?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah boleh baring guna dua bantal, doktor. Semalam kena duduk atas kerusi sepanjang malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Since admission, pak cik dah kencing banyak, berat turun 3 kilo. Kaki pun kurang bengkak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat suntik tu kuat betul, doktor. Asyik ke bilik air je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itu furosemide, ubat buang air. Hari ni kita teruskan dulu IV, esok tukar ke tablet.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik, sebelum masuk wad, ada makan ikan masin, budu, atau makanan masin?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, doktor. Ikan masin tiap hari, dengan nasi. Orang laut memang makan macam tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Garam tu yang buat air naik dalam badan. Your heart is weak, so dia tak boleh buang air lebih.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lepas balik, garam kena kurang betul-betul, and drink not more than 1.5 litre a day, termasuk kopi dan kuah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Satu setengah liter? Sikit tu, doktor. Pak cik selalu dahaga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cuba hisap ais kecil atau kunyah gula-gula tanpa gula, tu boleh kurangkan dahaga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kami juga nak pak cik timbang berat setiap pagi. Kalau naik lebih 2 kilo dalam tiga hari, datang klinik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kat rumah tak ada penimbang, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Anak pak cik boleh beli, tak mahal, dalam RM40. It's very important untuk jantung pak cik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, nanti pak cik suruh anak beli.

patient_persona.description: Madam Loh Siew Peng, 69, female, retired kindergarten teacher in Seremban; heart failure for two years, on perindopril. Clear, careful, asks about cost.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kenneth Yong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, cardiologist at a Seremban hospital heart failure clinic. Methodical and kind; Mandarin with English drug names and numbers.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 罗老师，你的 echo 还是显示 EF 百分之三十。虽然你感觉还可以，我想换一种更好的药。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 是什么药？我现在吃的 perindopril 不好吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Perindopril 有帮助，但是有一个新的药叫 sacubitril/valsartan，就是 Entresto，研究显示可以再减少住院和死亡。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那很好啊。可是贵不贵？我是退休老师，靠 pension 的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 在政府医院，如果符合 criteria，是免费给的。你符合，所以不用担心钱。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 换药的时候要注意。Perindopril 最后一粒吃完之后，要等 36 个小时，才可以开始 Entresto。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 为什么要等那么久？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 两个一起吃，会增加嘴唇和舌头肿的风险，叫 angioedema。等 36 小时比较安全。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我今天早上已经吃了 perindopril。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那就今天开始停。后天晚上开始 Entresto 24/26mg，一天两次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 两个星期后要回来验血，看 kidney 和 potassium，还有量血压，因为有时候会头晕。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果头晕怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 站起来慢慢站。如果收缩压低过 100，或者很晕，打电话来 clinic。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我写下来。36 小时，后天晚上开始，一天两次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，写得很清楚。其他的药，bisoprolol、spironolactone、dapagliflozin，照常吃。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Muthusamy a/l Karuppiah, 66, male, retired estate supervisor from Sungai Siput, Perak, Malaysian Indian; heart failure, knee osteoarthritis. Slow, deep voice, Manglish with Tamil-English rhythm.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nor Azura binti Hashim, Malay woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Perak health clinic. Direct and caring; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Muthusamy, your weight is up 4 kilos since last month, and your legs are very swollen. Nafas macam mana?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Getting worse, doctor. Last three nights I had to sleep sitting on the chair. Walk to the kedai also tak larat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Has anything changed? New medicines, more salt, missed your water pill?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No change lah. Oh, only my lutut very painful, so the farmasi gave me some pain pills. Very good, the pain gone.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can I see the pills? Ah, diclofenac 50mg. How many do you take?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Three times a day, doctor. Hampir three weeks already.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This is likely the reason. Diclofenac makes the body keep salt and water, and it's bad for the kidneys and the heart.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo, the farmasi never tell me. I thought ubat sakit all the same.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not all the same. Please stop the diclofenac today. For the knee, use paracetamol 1 gram up to four times a day, and a topical gel.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll increase your furosemide from 40mg to 80mg in the morning for five days, then back to 40mg.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your kidney test also came back a bit worse, creatinine 160. We'll recheck in one week.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, doctor. The knee really painful though. Walking to temple also susah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll refer you to physio, and we can consider a knee injection later. Whatever it is, no more NSAIDs, okay?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Faham. I'll tell my son to buang the tablets.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If you feel breathless even when resting, or can't lie down at all, go straight to the hospital, don't wait.

patient_persona.description: Puan Dayang Norlia binti Awang, 58, female, market trader from Tawau, Sabah; heart failure after a viral myocarditis. Cheerful, fast, Sabah Malay with "bah".

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lau Kian Ming, Sabahan Chinese man in his 30s, medical officer at a Tawau hospital clinic. Relaxed, careful; English-leaning, fluent Sabah Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Dayang, blood test minggu lepas, potassium puan tinggi, 5.8. Normal bawah 5.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Potassium tu apa, doktor? Bahaya ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Potassium tu garam dalam darah. Kalau terlalu tinggi, boleh ganggu rentak jantung. Tapi kita cepat tangkap, so tak apa.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ada makan banyak pisang bah, doktor. Orang cakap pisang bagus untuk jantung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pisang memang tinggi potassium. Puan makan berapa sehari?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga, empat biji. Saya jual pisang di tamu, jadi selalu makan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ha, itu salah satu sebab. Another cause is spironolactone, ubat yang tahan potassium dalam badan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita stop spironolactone buat sementara. Pisang kurangkan jadi satu biji sehari, and avoid durian dan air kelapa banyak-banyak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Air kelapa pun tak boleh? Aduh, panas-panas di Tawau ni.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sikit boleh, jangan satu biji penuh setiap hari. Garam pengganti low-sodium salt pun jangan guna, sebab ada potassium.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat lain teruskan ka, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Teruskan perindopril, bisoprolol, dan dapagliflozin. Furosemide pagi macam biasa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We'll repeat the potassium in one week. Kalau dah normal, mungkin kita start balik spironolactone dengan dos kecil.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau rasa berdebar-debar atau lemah, macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau jantung berdebar kuat, lemah sangat, atau nak pitam, terus pergi emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik bah, doktor. Minggu depan saya datang.

condition: Heart failure follow-up, orthopnoea and fluid restriction

patient_persona.description: Mr. Wong Yoke Fatt, 77, male, retired tin-mine worker in Taiping, Perak; heart failure, lives with his daughter. Slow, raspy voice, Cantonese-tinged Mandarin with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kavitha a/p Shanmugam, Malaysian Indian woman in her 40s, physician at a Taiping hospital clinic. Warm, clear; English with simple Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle Wong, 最近呼吸怎样？晚上睡觉躺得平吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 不行啊医生。躺平就喘，要垫三个枕头，有时候半夜醒来要坐起来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那个叫 orthopnoea，表示肺里面有水。脚肿不肿？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 肿，鞋子穿不下。我女儿说我的肚子也大了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你每天喝多少水？包括茶、汤、粥？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我很爱喝中国茶，一天可能五六杯。晚上还有汤。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 太多了，uncle。你的心脏 lemah，喝太多水，心脏排不掉，水就积在肺和脚。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 一天的水, 包括汤和茶, 最多一点五公升. Fill one big bottle every morning, 喝完就不能再喝.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一点五公升……好吧，我让女儿帮我量。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Furosemide 我帮你从 40mg 加到 80mg，早上吃。中午以后不要吃，不然晚上一直起来小便。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bisoprolol 现在 2.5mg，你的心跳 88，血压 132。我帮你加到 5mg。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 药越来越多，会不会伤肾？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们会看。今天验血，看 kidney 和 potassium。一个星期后再验一次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果还是喘呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 每天早上称体重。三天内重两公斤，或者坐着也喘，马上来 hospital，jangan tunggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我听医生的。谢谢你那么耐心。
